rule: per vector: among settings with valid-word rate >= 95% and distinct-3gram >= 90% of the unsteered dev reference, no letter-free traces, <= 2/48 traces under 32 tokens (collapse), and meta-mention rate <= reference + 10 pts, maximise strict compliance, then minimise wrong-case fraction, then prefer smaller r. Primary = A unless A's dev compliance is < half the best vector's or not above the unsteered reference.
